'''Alex Tennet''' (Decktech handle '''Greedo''') is a United Kingdom Star Wars CCG player and a member of [[Team OK-UK]] at [[DecipherCon 2000]]. Alan Rimmel made the shirts. Tennet recorded that [[Peter DiBiasio]] went undefeated and won Day 1 Swiss.<ref name="tennet">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-13-deciphercon-2000-juz-beer-and-cardsd1338/ deciphercon-2000-juz-beer-and-cards], Alex "Greedo" Tennet, Decktech (13 October 2000)</ref>
